messages:
maya: Quick thought — thinking of tightening weekly engineering triage: move to 20m + 10m async pre-read, add a 'hotfix lane' for critical/backlog owner handoff. Who's up for piloting next week? :hourglass_flowing_sand:
devon: +1 for shorter. Can we rotate owners every 2 weeks instead of weekly? reduces context switch.
sam: timezone note — mornings in US mean late in APAC. If we do 20m, can we alternate times weekly or keep same and rely on async?
maya: Good call @sam. Proposal: keep fixed slot (Tue 16:00 PT) for now, alternate owners, async pre-read for non-UTC folks to drop updates.
liam: I'll take first two-week slot if no one else. Also +1 on hotfix lane — suggest 5 min quick triage during call for any block that's >P0.
nora: For owner rotation, can we automate assignment using the 'triage-owners' calendar resource? I can add a rotator note in event description with overrides.
devon: How about this agenda template in cal event: 1) quick metrics (2m) 2) hotfix lane (5m) 3) backlog highlights (8m) 4) owner handoffs + blockers (5m). Thoughts?
maya: LGTM. Maybe swap backlog highlights and hotfix lane if there's a hotfix. Also add 'rollout watch' if any deployments in past 24h.
oncall-bot: incident-summary: No sev1 in last 7d. Recent deploys: canary v2.3.1 at 10:22 PT — no regressions detected. :white_check_mark:
sam: Can we add a persistent checklist in the event description? e.g.,
``
- Add pre-read link
- Attach repro logs (if any)
- Assign owner
``
nora: doing that now. I'll push an invite to eng-team and add rotation table. Also adding 'owner' as optional calendar slot so people can claim.
liam: One more ask — can we publish a small async template for pre-read to standardize (one-paragraph summary, impact, wanted outcome)? I can draft.
maya: Please do @liam, target to post by EOD Fri. If all good, we'll flip pilot next Tue. :rocket:
devon: Great. Who's in charge of the hotfix lane on-call during the meeting? Can we make it explicit in the invite description.
nora: I'll include 'hotfix owner' and link to rotation. Also set a followup thread link back here for decisions.
sam: ack. I'll update my calendar and drop the first pre-read tomorrow. Thanks everyone.
